summary:
Revised implementation plan restructuring the rollout into strict 'One Feature at a Time' phases:
Phase 1: Anti-Goals & Dopamine Shield (Not-To-Do avoid list with friction delay and cognitive reframing).
Phase 2: 90-Day Life Sprint & Identity Compass (quarterly progress bar & identity statements).
Phase 3: Circadian Sleep Architecture Clock (caffeine and screen cut-off countdowns).
Phase 4: Habit Staking Contracts (coin loss-aversion stakes).
Includes updated single-feature prompts for sequential execution across sessions.
